SELECT DISTINCT word, phonetic, definition, example, source_table FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(word USING utf8mb4) as word, CONVERT(phonetic USING utf8mb4) as phonetic, CONVERT(definition USING utf8mb4) as definition, CONVERT(example USING utf8mb4) as example, 'words' as source_table FROM words WHERE word LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') OR phonetic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%')
UNION
SELECT CONVERT(word USING utf8mb4) as word, CONVERT(phonetic USING utf8mb4) as phonetic, CONVERT(definition USING utf8mb4) as definition, CONVERT(example USING utf8mb4) as example, 'abroad_words' as source_table FROM abroad_words WHERE word LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') OR phonetic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%')
UNION
SELECT CONVERT(word USING utf8mb4) as word, CONVERT(phonetic USING utf8mb4) as phonetic, CONVERT(definition USING utf8mb4) as definition, CONVERT(example USING utf8mb4) as example, 'business_words' as source_table FROM business_words WHERE word LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') OR phonetic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') ) AS combined_results ORDER BY word
